retiredFailure.reason: unbounded target chasing produced looping, tangled, hierarchy-free spatial paths; learned stages were visually hidden by the final spaghetti result

visibleLearningStages: multi-tip target allocation and territory rays
hierarchical skeleton with explicit split nodes
antiCollapseConstraints: primary scaffold exists before target colonization
targets can only be claimed inside a tip forward cone
each growth step has a bounded maximum turn angle
tree lateral growth cannot fold radially back toward the trunk
candidate segments are rejected when they invade existing structure
splits require target-cluster separation, minimum group size, minimum tip age and maximum branch order
segment count and active-tip count are capped

scoreBoundary.tree: primary scaffold, forward/upward crown envelope and volumetric hierarchy
scoreBoundary.coral: substrate scaffold, near-planar fan envelope and denser terminal network
scoreBoundary.rule: Scores change envelopes and constraints; they do not modify the teacher engine or transfer biological parameters between objects.

graduationTest: remove the teacher UI; the instrument must still expose scaffold, target allocation, constrained continuation, split, occupancy, stop and load voices
qualityGates: maxTurnDeg remains within the configured bound plus split allowance
splitCount is greater than zero but not explosive
tree/coral Scores generate visibly different structures
all four learning stages are directly inspectable
